The '''QuietSnipe''' was a [[Sniper rifle/Legends|sniper rifle]] model that [[Magrifle/Legends|fired]] [[mag-pellet]] projectiles and featured a telescoping [[Barrel/Legends|barrel]]. [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Jaina Solo Fel|Jaina Solo]] utilized a QuietSnipe in the [[Second Battle of Roche]] during the [[Second Galactic Civil War]], when she attempted to [[Assassin/Legends|assassinate]] her brother, the [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Darth Caedus]], in the [[Strategic Planning Forum]] on the [[Asteroid/Legends|asteroid]] [[Nickel One]].

==Description==
The QuietSnipe was a [[Magrifle/Legends|magrifle]] that used [[Magnet/Legends|magnetic]] acceleration to fire [[mag-pellet]] projectiles. Classified as a [[Sniper rifle/Legends|sniper rifle]], the QuietSnipe featured a telescoping [[Barrel/Legends|barrel]], a front sight, and a trigger. The weapon could hold one magazine of a hundred mag-pellets at a [[Time/Legends|time]], which had to be attached to a feeder on the [[Rifle/Legends|rifle]]. The entirety of the QuietSnipe's mag-pellet magazine could be expended in three [[Standard second|seconds]] if one fired continuously, and the [[Sniper/Legends|sniper]] rifle could fire mag-pellets fast enough as to tear through seats or spin around a [[Human/Legends|man]] if he was hit.<ref name="Invincible" />

==History==
[[File:JainaSolo_EssentialAtlas.jpg|thumb|left|190px|Jaina Solo used a Quiet Snipe during a conflict on Nickel One.]]
The QuietSnipe was in circulation amidst the [[Second Galactic Civil War]], a chaotic conflict that saw the [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Darth Caedus]] lead elements of the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]] and other forces loyal to him against the [[Jedi Coalition]].<ref name="Invincible" /> In [[41 ABY]],<ref name="ERC" /> with the aid of the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorians]], the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Second Battle of Roche|assaulted]] the [[Roche system]], where Caedus resided on the [[Asteroid/Legends|asteroid]] [[Nickel One]], guarded by Galactic Alliance and [[Imperial Remnant/Legends|Imperial Remnant]] forces. During the fighting, [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Jaina Solo Fel|Jaina Solo]], Caedus' sister, infiltrated the asteroid's defenses armed with a QuietSnipe in an attempt to [[Assassin/Legends|assassinate]] her sibling.<ref name="Invincible" />

While Caedus fought a Mandalorian team in the asteroid's [[Strategic Planning Forum]], Solo, perched in a nearby projection booth, found her brother within her QuietSnipe's sights. Solo managed to send a mag-pellet through Caedus' shoulder, but the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] evaded any further projectiles. Solo then resorted to using her [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] as she pressed an attack that ultimately saw Caedus [[Cho mai/Legends|lose]] an [[Limb/Legends|arm]] before he retreated.<ref name="Invincible" />

==Behind the scenes==
The QuietSnipe appeared in [[Troy Denning]]'s [[Legacy of the Force: Invincible|''Invincible'']], the final novel of the ''[[Star Wars: Legacy of the Force]]'' series, released in [[2008]].<ref name="Invincible" />
